definitions.explanation: Giving oneself completely to a person, cause, or activity; showing self-sacrificing commitment.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{献身的|けんしんてき}に{患者|かんじゃ}の{世話|せわ}をした。
examples.english: She devoted herself to caring for the patient.

examples.japanese: {献身的|けんしんてき}な{愛情|あいじょう}で{子供|こども}を{育|そだ}てた。
examples.english: She raised her children with devoted love.

examples.japanese: {ボランティア|ぼらんてぃあ}の{献身的|けんしんてき}な{活動|かつどう}に{感謝|かんしゃ}します。
examples.english: I appreciate the volunteers' dedicated efforts.

examples.japanese: {献身的|けんしんてき}なサポートのおかげで{回復|かいふく}できた。
examples.english: Thanks to the devoted support, I was able to recover.

notes:
USAGE: {献身的|けんしんてき} describes selfless devotion, often in the context of care, service, or love. It has a positive connotation implying admirable self-sacrifice.

NOUN/VERB: {献身|けんしん} (devotion, dedication)

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{献身的|けんしんてき}に{尽|つ}くす (serve devotedly)
・{献身的|けんしんてき}な{介護|かいご} (devoted nursing care)
・{献身的|けんしんてき}な{愛|あい} (selfless love)
・{献身的|けんしんてき}に{働|はたら}く (work devotedly)

CONTEXTS: Often used for caregiving, nursing, parenting, volunteer work, and religious service.
